column3: Sluggish start - settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f to run - progress made in the closing stages - fought to the front close home to score

Settled in the pack - asked for effort with over two furlongs left - moved through to the front a furlong out - came under pressure from rivals close home - lost the advantage inside the final 110 yards - could find no more and finished second
Sat close to pace early - pushed along with over 2f left and challenged hard inside final furlong - lost ground close home to finish third
Settled at the back - pushed along approaching final 2f - progress inside the last furlong - stayed on to finish fourth
Settled in the pack - urged forward with 2f left before finding progress inside the final furlong - stayed on at one level to finish 5th beaten 3.25 lengths
Held up handy in the pack - pushed along approaching 2f out then lost ground with a furlong left - kept going without gaining inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Held a spot near the front - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost touch and dropped away inside the final furlong - finished well held in 7th
Settled towards the back of the pack - failed to get involved - well held in 8th
Settled towards the back early - fought for control off the pace - unable to land a blow late on - finished 9th beaten 8 lengths
Keen to lead early and fighting the bridle - pressed for effort 2f out then overtaken inside the final furlong - dropped away quickly to finish last
Held up towards the back showing early enthusiasm - failed to land a blow - finished well held in 11th

Front at the off - passed after 1f but in touch - shared the front from 4f and back in front by halfway - driven to stamp authority entering the straight - four lengths to the good over 1f out - answer needed late as the gap narrowed - stayed on to win

Sat close to the front early - 6th with 4f left - nudged into 5th over 2f out - into 4th then up to 2nd inside the final 2f - unable to reach winner entering last furlong - kept responding to close home for a narrow defeat
Settled midpack early - up to 4th with 4f left - pushed into 3rd 2f out - unable to threaten leaders and stayed on same gear to finish 3rd
Settled just behind the leaders early - 7th with 4f remaining - driven on turning for home - 6th and unable to close 1f out - stayed on same rhythm to finish fourth

Close up early - hit front after 1f - headed and settled second at halfway - urged on turning for home - drifted left approaching 2f out - fourth and unable to threaten 1f out before fading to finish 5th

Slow to stride - settled in the back group and pulled hard - sixth of eight with four furlongs left - driven on the outside rail entering the straight - made no inroad from a furlong out and finished sixth
Slow to break - settled handy early before slipping to the back past 4f - urged into the straight - pressed for effort 2f out - unable to find more and finished well beaten in 7th
Slow to begin - settled handy while fighting for the bridle - moved up to sit third after three furlongs - found nothing more in fourth two out - eased back to fifth and faded late

Settled in the back markers and fought for control early - travelling strongly outside and up to 4th by halfway - 5th with 4f remaining then driven into 6th turning in - lost touch with the front and dropped away
Fought for control early - tracked the pace then closed on the front-runner and pushed along 2f out - went to the front soon after - stayed on strongly through the last furlong to win
Set the pace early - driven along and challenged for the front 2f out before being overtaken - lost momentum in the closing stages to finish second
Fought for control early - settled off the pace within range - pressed for effort inside final furlong but couldn't find extra - finished third
Settled behind pace early - improved into second by halfway and narrowed gap 4f out - driven to front 1 1/2f out and stayed on strongly to win
Tracked the front pair early - 4th at halfway - improved into contention 4f out and pushed along entering the straight in 3rd - stayed on same gear to snatch 2nd close home

Set off in front and opened a big margin - eight lengths to the good at halfway - gap narrowed with 4f to run - caught 1½f out under pressure and unable to challenge again - held on for third finishing one paced
Sat behind the pacesetter early - 3rd at halfway and closing 4f out - into 4th entering the straight then driven and stayed on at one gear inside the final furlong to finish 4th
Held up towards the back of the pack - made headway 4f from home into 7th entering the straight - unable to threaten leaders from 2f out and well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - urged into 10th turning for home - stayed on steadily late without threatening the finish
Towards the back of the pack - moved up approaching 4f out and 5th entering the straight - found nothing from 1 1/2f out and finished well held in 7th
Held up in the pack - 8th and driven with 3f left - never involved in the finish - well held in 8th
Set the pace early - dropped to 5th around halfway and asked for effort 4f out - into 6th entering the straight without threatening - held no more thereafter finishing 9th
Held up towards back of the field - driven approaching straight but made no headway - asked for more before fading - finished 10th
Settled in the pack - urged for effort but found little approaching 4f out - dropped away to trail home well beaten
Held up at the back - driven and losing touch 6f from home - dropped away and eased out of contention 2f from the finish
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with two furlongs left - responded and closed ground inside the final furlong to finish third
Settled towards the back - pressed into contention 2f out then angled right for room approaching final furlong - progress inside the last - claimed fourth close home
Settled towards the back of the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - blocked for room a furlong out - stayed on to finish 5th
Up with the pace early - pressed for effort with 2f left before fading and edging off a straight line inside the final furlong - beaten easily to finish sixth
Settled close up early - pushed along with 2f left then edged in front briefly inside final furlong - swiftly overtaken and dropped away tamely to finish seventh
Sent clear early - pressed for effort passing the furlong marker and lost the advantage - dropped away fast close home - beaten well into 8th
Sluggish start - held up towards rear pulling hard for most of the trip - never able to threaten - well held into 9th
Set the pace from the off - three lengths clear with 3f remaining - driven out from 2f out and staying on strongly to the line despite the margin narrowing in the closing strides

Dwelt at the start - settled towards the back of the field - fifth into the straight and fourth 2f out - unable to make any inroads when asked 1 1/2f out - finished strongly to claim second in the final 100 yards but no danger to the winner
Sat close up early holding some enthusiasm - asked for effort 2f out - unable to close the gap approaching final furlong and a half - stayed on same gear - held place in 3rd with nothing more late
Slow into stride - settled just behind leaders - third turning for home - urged forward 2f out - couldn't gain ground 1.5f out - stayed on same rate to finish fourth
Settled towards back of the field - pushed along in 5th approaching 2f out - unable to find more before the line
Settled just off the pace - urged into 4th turning into the straight - faded from contention approaching the last two furlongs to finish sixth
Hampered leaving the stalls - settled in the pack under a firm grip - progress and pushed along 2f out - ran on strongly in the final 110yds to gain the lead on the line
Drifted right early - settled handy - pressed for effort 2f out and moved into command inside final furlong - held on well but caught right on the line
Tracked the front-runner - pushed alongside 2f out and looked capable of winning inside the final furlong - flattened out and gave up second close home to finish third
Pulled hard early - settled towards the back - made ground 2f out - up with the front group entering the final furlong - plugged on at one speed to finish fourth

Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - hit the front - driven along and challenged for command inside final 2f - drifted off a true line and passed approaching last furlong before fading close home to finish 5th
Settled at back early - still within range 2f out - pushed along a furlong out - finished off well without threatening the front - eventually 6th beaten 3.75 lengths
Sat close to the front pack early - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - dropped away soon after - came home well held in 7th
Settled in the pack early - up to 4th at halfway then 3rd before two out - shaken up to hit the front approaching the straight and a furlong and a half out - driven out to hold on gamely to the line

Sat close up early - stumbled 3rd - up into 2nd by halfway - moved into command soon after the last - driven on entering straight and overtaken 1 1/2f out - unable to challenge again and stayed on same speed to finish 2nd
Settled in the pack - small error at the 3rd - improved into 6th with two to jump - 4th and driven turning for home - stayed on into 3rd inside the final furlong and a half
Held up towards the back - made progress before 2 out - into 3rd entering the straight and pushed along - unable to threaten leaders over 1f out and held on for 4th
Sat close to the front pack early - 5th at halfway - into 4th and driven approaching straight - unable to find extra in 5th inside final furlong and finished one-paced
Sat close to front group early - 3rd at halfway - asked for effort into straight but made no headway inside final 2f - stayed on same gear to finish 6th
Settled around midfield - 8th and driven approaching straight with no headway made - stayed on same tempo to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - shaken up but unable to gain on the leaders after the final flight - ninth entering the straight then plugged on steadily to finish 8th
Went straight to front and opened up two lengths by halfway - driven and overtaken close to the last - dropped away quickly to run seventh entering the straight - unable to find more late on
Sat close to the front group early - 6th at halfway - driven with no gain made before 2 out - dropped away quickly to finish last of all
Held up at the back throughout - driven with no headway 2 out - error at the last - faded to finish well beaten in 11th
Handy early - hit first fence and needed urging soon after - dropped towards the back with more urging before 4 out - lost touch quickly - well beaten at the finish
Towards the back of the pack - struggling and dropped right away after 3 out before the rider's feet left the stirrups momentarily - error and unseated rider 2 out
Held up towards the back - stumbled and dislodged rider at the opening fence
Settled towards the back - roused up 2f out and angled right for a gap over 1f out - picked up well inside the final furlong - asserted in the closing stages to score with something in hand
Held up close to the front - pushed to challenge over 2f out - edged in front inside the final furlong - overtaken close home - unable to find more before finishing second
Set the pace early - under pressure and overtaken 2f out - lost position inside final furlong - faded to finish third beaten 3.25 lengths
Dwelt at the start settling last - pushed along approaching 2f out - stayed on late to close gap slightly but not enough to land involved in finish
Held a central position early - pressed for effort with 4f left then again with 3f to run - lost touch with leaders soon after - kept plugging on in the closing stages to finish fifth
Settled in third early - pushed along with over 3f left - dropped away soon after and finished well beaten in 6th
Up with the pace and showing some early enthusiasm - moved to the fore just inside 2f out - challenged hard over 1f out but held on - pulled clear in the final 100 yards to win
Settled in rear on the inside - 4th entering the final 3f - no room 2f out and had to wait - angled left 1f out - failed to quicken and plugged on for 3rd
Handy early - hit the front and travelled keenly - urged on entering straight - overtaken with 2f left - unable to respond - 4th finishing spot with little more to offer

Sluggish start - settled towards the back - 5th turning for home - shaped up on the inner from 2f out - boxed in with 1.5f left - asked for effort inside final furlong - unable to find more and finished one-paced in 5th
Sat close to pace early fighting for control - slipped to the back turning into the straight - allowed to coast 2f out - finished well beaten in last
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - travelling comfortably 2f out - pushed along and found room between rivals entering final furlong - stayed on strongly to hit the front right on the line
Disputed the lead on the far rail - pressed 2f out - stayed on through the final furlong but collared in the closing strides to finish second by half a length
Settled in mid-pack down the middle - pressed for effort 2f out - closed on the front-runner with a furlong left - stayed on but edged out of second close home

Settled mid-division through open ground - improved into contention 2f out - pressed for effort soon after - looked a threat entering last furlong - held gait to the line but edged out for third close home - finished fourth
Settled in mid-field down the middle - shared front spot before being overhauled a furlong out - weakened in the closing stages to finish fifth
Settled just off the pack from mid-division - pushed along 2f out - stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled towards the back on the far flank - pushed along with 2f left - failed to land a blow - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish seventh

Knocked at the start - travelled among the middle group sharing the front spot - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost position and knocked again entering the final furlong - dropped away to finish eighth
Drifted left at the off - settled mid-group - never involved - finished well beaten in 9th
Sat up with the pace through midfield - pressed for effort 2f out and dropped away - faded quickly thereafter - finished well beaten in 10th
Towards the back early - improved into midfield by halfway - moved up to 6th turning in - driven to the front inside the last - stayed on strongly to score

Up with leaders and hit front before the 2nd - driven approaching the straight and asked for effort - overtaken early in the last furlong then stayed on same rate to finish second beaten three quarters of a length
Settled midfield early - improved into 4th before the straight then up to 3rd and pushed along a furlong out - unable to threaten the front two and finished third one-paced

Went straight to front - lost the advantage before the 2nd and sat close up into halfway - asked for effort entering the straight - down to 4th with a furlong left - unable to threaten those ahead and finished at a steady gallop
Handy behind front group early - 5th at halfway - driven before two out and dropped to 7th entering straight - stayed on same gait to finish 5th
Sat close to front group early - 4th at halfway - dropped to 5th and asked for effort into the straight - no headway under pressure 1f out and stayed on same gear to finish sixth
Held up in the pack - minor error 4 out - stayed on steadily but no real threat in the straight
Held up towards back - improved on outside to 6th entering straight - unable to challenge and one-paced from 1½f out - eventually well held
Set the pace early - sat behind the front pair in third at halfway - driven and dropped away turning into the straight then had nothing left to offer
Sat close to the front pack early - up to 3rd entering the straight under pressure - then unable to find more and well held at the finish
Held up towards back of field - lost more ground before 2 out - couldn't find more late - finished 11th
Held up at the back throughout - made no impression through the race - dropped away well behind late finishing last
Held up towards the back of the pack - lost touch with those ahead before 2 out - trailed home well beaten
Slow to break and unwilling to settle into stride - eased and withdrawn from contention soon after
Settled in the pack early - driven into the front spot a furlong out - drew away from the field to score comfortably
Handy in the early stages - pressed for effort with over two furlongs left - kept battling on the inner in the closing stages - moved into second close home - always held by the winner
Broke to the right at the start - held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 3f left - stayed on inside the closing furlong - edged out of second late to finish third
Set the pace early - pushed along and lost command inside the final two furlongs - faded late to finish fourth
Sluggish start - settled towards the back pulling hard - roused into effort with 3f left - stayed on at one tempo without threatening from 2f out
Jumped smartly to lead - eased the tempo at halfway - pressed forward to stamp authority entering the straight - forged ahead over 1f out and stayed on strongly to win

Sat close up early and shifted to inner rail - 2nd after a furlong - dropped to 3rd turning in - pressed for effort 2f out - back to 2nd inside final furlong but unable to threaten winner - stayed on same gear to finish 2nd
Sat behind the front group - 6th at halfway - urged into effort 2f out - up to 4th and driven 1 1/2f out - third under pressure but unable to close 1f out - stayed on same gear to finish third

Slow into stride and hesitated - sat up behind the front group pulling hard early then bumped after 1f - 5th at halfway - driven into 6th 2f out - unable to close when asked 1.5f out - 5th entering final furlong - stayed on same effort to finish
Sat handy behind the front group - 3rd at halfway - into 2nd early in the straight but unable to threaten - driven and dropped to 4th inside the final furlong - finished 5th without responding
Sat close to the pace on the wide side - 4th at halfway - asked for effort 2f out but made little headway - held 6th spot inside final furlong and stayed on same pace to finish sixth

Slow into stride and hesitant to settle - pulling hard on the inner in the pack - hampered after a furlong and a half - 7th at halfway - pressed for effort 2f out but couldn't find more - finished 7th well beaten
Held up in the pack early asked for effort - 8th at halfway then given a squeeze 2f out - unable to find more and stayed on for 8th
Slow to break - held up towards the back on the rail - 10th at halfway - pushed along 2f out with little response - finished 9th
Settled in the pack early - 9th at halfway then pushed into 7th with 2f left - couldn't find more and finished well held
Held up at the back throughout - 12th at halfway - pushed along with 2f left but unable to find more - finished well beaten in 11th
Sluggish start - held up at the back and unable to threaten the front runners - driven with 2f left but couldn't quicken - finished well held in 12th
Slow to break - held up at back of the field throughout - lost more ground into the straight then eased away from contention finishing well beaten in 13th
Tardy away - settled at the back throughout and out of contention - 11th at halfway - nudged up entering the straight - faded to finish well adrift

Settled close to the pace early - moved into second with 3f left - pushed along 2f out - lost momentum for a moment turning into the straight - responded strongly in the final 110 yards - got up to win on the line
Went straight to front - clear by a length with 2f remaining - asked for effort soon after - held on well into the final furlong - caught close to the line
Slow to break and settled last - travelling well with 2f remaining and pushed along to press the pace - lost touch in the closing stages to finish third
Pulled hard early - up with the pace - dropped to third 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out then faded late to finish fourth
Hampered start - close to front early - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost place inside final furlong to finish 5th
Held up early towards the back - improved into second before three out then hit the front after the following fence - driven out to easily assert on the run to the line

Set off in front and quickly opened a big margin - still 20 lengths to the good at halfway - gap narrowed 4 out after an awkward jump - driven approaching the straight then overtaken after 2 out and unable to respond on the run-in

Held a handy tow behind the front-runner early - back in modest fourth at halfway - made headway before four out - into third and pressed from two out - unable to threaten up the straight - stayed on at one gait to finish third
Held up towards the back - improved 4 out to 5th entering the straight - pushed along into 4th before the last but couldn't threaten leaders on the run-in

Settled in the pack early holding a modest position - improved into contention with four to jump before pressed for effort entering the straight and up to 7th two out - 6th before the last then stayed on steadily to finish
Settled midfield off the tempo - made headway 4 out - 6th and driven turning into straight - unable to make ground after 2 out and finished without more to offer
Held up towards the back of the pack - unable to make headway from 3 out - stayed on same speed through the finish without threatening
Tracked the front-runner in the early stages - closed in 4 out and up to 3rd soon after - dropped to 4th under pressure after 2 out and could find nothing more late
Settled in the pack off the gallop - made ground into contention 4 out - driven on straightening but unable to threaten and held to the line
Tracked the front-runner early - midfield around halfway - improved position 4 out - dropped to 7th and driven entering the straight before finishing without response
Towards the back from the off - well behind after the 10th - no response when pushed along - finished distanced in 11th
Held up at the back of the field - lost touch after the 10th and unable to build on it from 3 out - well beaten at the finish
Settled behind the front-runner - untidy over 6th and only fair in 2nd around halfway - making up ground when stumbling and losing rider 4 out
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f remaining - swept to the front inside the final 110 yards - drew clear for an emphatic success
Handy early - pushed to challenge the pace-setter approaching 2f out - stayed on without heading up before fading close home

Settled just behind the pace early - moved through to hit the front after 4f - driven approaching the final furlong - held on under pressure inside the last - overtaken close home and unable to fight back
Held up mid-pack under pressure early - asked for effort with 2f left - stayed on inside final furlong without troubling leaders
Held up towards the back showing eagerness - pushed along with over 3f left - crept into contention passing tired horses inside the final furlong - then faded quickly to finish fifth
Settled towards the back - pushed along with 2f remaining - kept on at one tempo late - finished sixth
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early and set the pace - lost the advantage after 4f but stayed close up - asked for effort with 2f left - dropped away rapidly to finish 7th beaten 16 lengths

Driven up early to race handy - hit front after 1f and shifted to inner rail - set the tempo from there - eased tempo at halfway - urged forward 2f out - given a squeeze 1½f out - firmly challenged inside final furlong - stayed on to prevail

Slow into stride from stalls - settled midfield on rail - 6th at halfway - driven forward and made progress early in straight - into 2nd though drifted left approaching 1½f out - pressed home turn into final furlong - finished strongly but denied

Settled in the pack - 8th at halfway - grabbed the bit entering the straight and had to be driven - angled left 1 1/2f out and made progress - moved into 3rd 1f out - stayed on strongly in the final 150 yards but could not get to the front two - 3rd beaten half a length

Slow to begin - towards the back and 10th at halfway - squeezed for space nearing the straight - pushed along with 2f left - unable to threaten leaders inside final furlong - stayed on late to finish 4th
Handy early - up with the front group and third by halfway - fourth and driven 2f out - hampered heavily inside final furlong with no response - stayed on same gait to finish 5th
Settled in midfield - 7th at halfway - driven approaching straight without gaining ground - stayed on same rate to finish 6th beaten 3.25 lengths

Settled in the middle section on the inner - 5th at halfway - grabbed the bit approaching the straight and came up with the front group 2f out but found the gap shut - angled away from the rail over 1f out only to be bumped - no run again at the 1f marker and faded from contention to finish 7th
Held up towards the back from the off - pressed for effort early - unable to threaten the front end - finished well held in 8th
Settled towards the back early - 9th at halfway - asked for effort into the straight - driven approaching final furlong - unable to threaten leaders and finished ninth
Slow to break and lost ground early - held up towards the back and unable to land a blow - shaken up but only stayed on same speed for tenth
Held up handy early - sitting just behind the pace after a furlong - urged forward 2f out but unable to make headway - 6th with a furlong left - faded to finish 11th beaten 6¾ lengths
Raced keenly close up wide early - up with the pace and 4th at halfway - unable to land a blow under pressure 2f out and faded late
Set the pace from the start - roused along three furlongs out - pushed for extra approaching the final furlong under pressure from a rival - stayed on strongly to the line
Slowly into stride at the rear - settled early - made progress from 3f out - closed on leader 2f out - pressed inside final furlong but edged out close home
Sat behind the front group - pushed along over 2f out then urged along inside the final furlong - third and unable to challenge - stayed on to the line
Tracked leader until 2f out - dropped away soon after - well held in 4th
Set the pace from the off - clear by a length at halfway - driven into a firm lead 2 out and stayed strong to the line

Settled in midfield - 5th at halfway - niggled for effort and briefly bumped moving into 4th entering the straight - up to 3rd 2 out - second at the last but unable to challenge winner and stayed on same speed to finish 2nd
Sat close to the pace early - up to 2nd by halfway then driven approaching the straight but unable to threaten the winner after the second-last - held 3rd through the finish
Sat close behind front group early - 4th at halfway and into 3rd turning for home under a ride - 4th again after 2 out unable to threaten - stayed on same gear to finish 4th
Settled at the back of the field - lost touch with the pack before 4 out - stayed on steadily up the straight to finish 5th
Sat close to the pace - 3rd at halfway - eased back to 6th 3 out and lacked response to the finish
Held up at back of field early - lost touch with leaders with no threat by 4 out - driven but couldn't quicken into straight - finished well adrift in 7th
Held up towards the back of the pack early - improved into 6th by halfway then up to 3rd approaching 3 out - going smoothly close to the front before losing footing entering the straight
Went straight to front - urged forward approaching 3f out - overtaken and driven out with 1f left - fought back inside final furlong - found extra in last 110yds to prevail narrowly
Sat second early - pushed along three out - hit front a furlong out - overtaken approaching the line - battled on to finish second by a short margin
Settled in third early - pushed along with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - held on for third

Settled just off the pace - 6th at halfway - asked for effort early in straight - made ground over 1f out - into 5th and battling 1f out - locked together entering final 100 yards - stayed on to prevail right at the line

Settled just off the pace early - 5th at halfway - urged forward with two furlongs left - into 4th with a furlong to run - driven out and into contention 100 yards from home - fought on gamely - overhauled in the final strides

Sent forward from the off - shaken up when caught 2f from home - briefly disputed front early in final furlong - overtaken and dropped to 3rd close home - unable to threaten front pair - stayed on same gait to finish 3rd

Sluggish start and brushed early - sat handy on the rail fighting for control - third at halfway then fourth into the straight - denied room and asked for effort from 2f out - dropped to sixth without threatening after edging left with a furlong left - rallied under pressure to stay on and finish fourth

Sat close to the front pair - 4th at halfway - up to 3rd turning in - shared the lead going strongly 2f out - driven approaching the furlong pole and lost the advantage soon after - unable to find more late and finished 5th
Up with the pace - pressed to share second 2f out - lost place 1 1/2f out - nothing left in the closing stages
Held up early - driven approaching straight - unable to make headway - well held at finish

Settled off the pace in the pack - progress made three furlongs out to take command with over two left - drifted left while inexperienced approaching the last furlong - opened up a big advantage inside it - allowed to coast home unchallenged

Settled towards the back of the pack early - made ground into contention approaching the final furlong - moved into second inside the last but couldn't threaten the winner - stayed on to the line for second
Sat close to the pace early - faded from contention over 2f out before finding renewed energy in the closing stages to snatch third
Sat handy behind the front group early - wandered left approaching 2f out showing inexperience - kept on at an even effort inside the closing stages to finish fourth
Sat close behind the pacesetter - pressed for effort approaching 2 out - held level through the closing stages to finish fifth

Sluggish start - settled towards the back - pushed along with two furlongs left and gained ground while drifting left approaching the final furlong - unable to find more inside it and beaten into sixth
Made the running - lost the advantage and drifted left approaching 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 7th
Sluggish start - trailed the field throughout - dropped further off pace inside final two furlongs - finished last of the group
Settled in the pack early - moved into contention before 4 out to sit third 2 out then edged in front approaching the last - driven out to hold on gamely to the line
Sat behind the pace early - up into 4th by 3 out then 2nd approaching the run-in - driven out and stayed on to finish second by three-quarters of a length
Settled towards the back of the pack - improved from 3 out to lie 5th before the second last - pushed along nearing the final flight and finished strongly to claim 3rd on the run-in

Settled behind the front group early - up to 3rd by halfway then 2nd approaching 3 out before hitting the front briefly - shaken up but lost command before the last - unable to find more up the run-in finishing 4th
Set the pace early - margin cut back approaching 4 out - driven and overtaken before 2 out - dropped to 4th before the last and held no more finishing off
Sat close to the front early - 4th at halfway - pushed along and dropped back after 3 out - down to 8th soon after before staying on at one gait up the straight
Sat close to the front group early - up in 4th before 4 out - driven but unable to close after the following fence - dropped to 7th with two left before staying on at one gear to finish 7th
Held up towards the back - stumbled at the second - no impression made and plugged on steadily in the straight to finish eighth
Sat close to pace early - up in 2nd at halfway - dropped to 6th and driven before 2 out - blundered last and held on for same effort
Midpack early but ragged over the opening obstacle - dropped towards the back soon after - held no chance from 3 out and unable to find more late finishing tenth
Settled in the pack early - stumbled fractionally at the second and third - driven from three out but unable to find more - finished well beaten in 11th
Towards the back of the pack early - bumped soon after the off - little impression made through the race - held no chance from 3 out to the finish
Sat close to the front group early - 5th at halfway - urged on before a heavy error 4 out saw slip back through the pack and finish with nothing more to give
Held up at the back of the field - lost touch before 4 out - pulled up before the last
Quick away to lead throughout - urged as drifting towards the fence with two furlongs left then challenged approaching the last furlong and a half - responded strongly to hold on close home

Held up towards the back - still 9th at halfway - went wide into straight and made progress - up to 2nd with 2f left - driven to attack 1 1/2f out but unable to get on terms - drifted right inside final furlong and stayed on at one gait to finish 2nd
Settled midpack early - 6th at halfway - urged forward entering the straight - up to 3rd with 2f left - drifted left with no real threat - stayed on at one speed to finish 3rd
Held up towards the back - still 11th at halfway - urged into contention 2f out - unable to threaten leaders and stayed on same gait - finished 4th

Sat behind the front group on the inner and fought for control - 4th at halfway - asked for effort when denied room 2f out - shifted left after being bumped inside the final 2f - unable to find more and finished 5th one-paced

Stumbled at the start losing ground - settled midfield on the rail - 8th at halfway - urged forward two out - driven approaching the final furlong without threatening leaders - stayed on same gear to finish sixth
Sat behind front group early - 3rd at halfway - asked for effort 2f out and faded from there

Slow to begin - held up towards the back and 10th at halfway - boxed in with two furlongs left - shifted right and driven on approaching the furlong marker - unable to land a blow - beaten 6 lengths in 8th
Held a midpack spot early - 7th at halfway then knocked sideways 2f out prompting a rousting - unable to find more finishing 9th
Missed the break badly and settled at the back - shown no encouragement turning for home - unable to make any headway thereafter - finished well held in 10th
Sat close behind pace early keen in hand - unable to find extra when knocked and blocked approaching 2f out - dropped away finishing well beaten
